user_request: Deploy a Flask web application with PostgreSQL database and Redis for caching. The Flask app should run on port 5000, PostgreSQL on 5432, and Redis on 6379.
generated_config:
name: flask-demo
services:
  flask:
    image: python:3.12-slim
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    environment:
      FLASK_APP: app.py
      FLASK_ENV: production
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - redis
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: flaskdb
      POSTGRES_USER: flaskuser
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: flaskpass
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
